# Short coupon fixture: coupon_20x20x15.stl

20 x 20 x 15 mm prism on Z=0, centred on X=Y=0 - the same cross-section
as coupon_20x20x60.stl at a quarter of the height.

## Why it exists
The gap sweep varies one number across several coupons, and whether the
two slot walls fuse is visible within the first few body layers. At
0.20 mm layers the 60 mm coupon is ~21 minutes and 295 body layers; this
is ~5 minutes and 70. The slot geometry is identical, so the fusion
answer is identical.

## What it does NOT replace
The 60 mm coupon remains M1's reference fixture: its G-code, layer count
and one-loop verification are cited in the milestone evidence. Use this
one to find the working gap, then confirm on the full coupon.

Generated by `python tools/make_fixtures.py coupon-short`.
